item.title: I did it again.
item.description: I'm sorry. I'm really so sorry. I just wanted it to look nicer. It was only the front page this time. OKAY! OKAY! AND I finished the All Games page. Are you happy now? All my games chronologically from newest to oldest? I'm... I'm... Sorry.

item.title: New Website Design!
item.description:
Today I felt rather unhappy with my website, so I redid it all again! Completely new! It'll take some time for it to have all the stuff I want it to have but I fuck with it so far.
Don't worry if you missed the old site design, like all the others, it is archived and accessible! I might have to go back and update the images for all my old RSS posts though... ugh..................... ( it is rather weird to type out onamatopeia. it's like when someone's trying to seek out attention so they type "sigh..." in the chat or some bollocks. )

item.title: New Site (not) Christmas Update
item.description: Got a new site update out for (not) christmas!! (but instead January 7th) Because the old one was messy as hell. The news page now reads from the RSS feed instead of me manually having to do it...... It's lit. Shame the eye's gone though. I'll be trying to return the cool level of the site in the coming times though.... merry (not) christmas (but January 7th)....
